_doc: Bosch Rexroth's 10 mm slot as its 45 mm light (L) and super light (SL) strut profiles have it. Opening (10), lip (6), cavity width (20,1) and depth (14,5) are printed on the catalogue's drawing; the width of the floor and the angle of the flanks are scaled off it, and say so. The drawn slot has solid lips where the light sections' are hollow hooks, and a flat floor where theirs is the round core. It takes the same nuts as the 40 mm series' 10 mm slot.
name: slot-10-bosch-45l

opening.rule: Slot width between the lips, 10 on the drawing
opening.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 2-23, as republished by RS Components (document A700000009494056)

lip_thickness.rule: From the face to the underside of the lip where it meets the cavity's wall: the drawing's 6. The light lip is a hook: a thin wall along the opening and a plate under it, hollow between
lip_thickness.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 2-23, as republished by RS Components (document A700000009494056)

cavity_width.rule: Width under the lips, 20,1 on the drawing
cavity_width.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 2-23, as republished by RS Components (document A700000009494056)

cavity_depth.rule: From the face to the core, 14,5 on the drawing for the light (L) and super light (SL) sections
cavity_depth.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 2-23, as republished by RS Components (document A700000009494056)

floor_width.rule: Width of the floor, taken where the flanks' lines meet it: the walls run straight to about 10.9 mm below the face, then close in at 45 degrees along the webs to the round core (ø16), which is the floor. Not dimensioned: measure yours
floor_width.source: scaled off the section drawing on Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 2-23, as republished by RS Components (document A700000009494056) (the drawing prints no figure for it)

flank_angle.rule: The flanks close in at 45 degrees, as drawn. Not dimensioned
flank_angle.source: scaled off the section drawing on Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 2-23, as republished by RS Components (document A700000009494056) (the drawing prints no figure for it)

nut_family.rule: It takes Rexroth's 10 mm slot nuts, as the 40 mm series does
nut_family.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 2-23, as republished by RS Components (document A700000009494056)
